regions.name: bottom-margin

spectrum.model: generation profile = measured radial amplitude rings 5..128 (log-log interpolated), rings 2..4 held at ring-5 level (below 200px-window resolution; measured low rings are taper-leakage-inflated), f<2 zero

generation.note: gamma pre-compensates the high-frequency distortion introduced by white-anchored clipping at 255, so the decoded mean |laplacian| matches the reference

grain-tile-light.webp.anchor: white-anchored dark-only grain (multiply-safe): decoded mean 253.83 -> multiply darkens #F4F4EE paper by 1.12/255 at opacity 1 (inside Heron's ±2/255 sampling variance)

grain-tile-dark.webp.anchor: #282828 (40,40,40) = Madarek dark paper --neutral-50; symmetric grain (both polarities)
grain-tile-dark.webp.targetRationale: no dark Heron captures exist (r314 light-only; r313 reference light-only) -> task fallback: amplitude x0.8 of light reference, neutral #282828

light.autocorr1px vs reference.note: informational grain character; one-sided (dark-only) multiply grain cannot keep the symmetric reference's small positive lag-1 correlation while also matching std + mean|lap| — the residual is imperceptible at 0.7% amplitude

tileabilityVerdict.method: wrap-seam adjacent-pixel |Δ| stats vs interior baseline (a real seam = systematic step/larger deltas at the wrap); plus col/row-mean steps; plus 2x2 composite col/row-mean discontinuity (<1.5 gate)

dark.note: dark tile mean = #282828 = Madarek charcoal paper -> use plain alpha compositing (NO blend mode): zero colour shift, full amplitude transfer; applied sigma = tile_std * opacity
